page.layout: Top: a decorative woodcut border. Below it: the centred title in capitals and italic, three lines of text in larger and smaller type. Then a section letter "A." centred. Below that, two parallel columns of index entries: left column, then right column. At the bottom right, the catchword "Astra:". No running head or page number is printed.

page.notes: Woodcut initial A in "ACademiarum" is joined to the word. Doubtful: "Asclerarion" (possibly Asclepiarion or similar), marked [?].
